title: Create: Geo-Resonance
description: Uncover the depths of the world with seismic prospecting!
body:
![Hero Banner](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_cfdee45a-2fd6-4a21-8ac0-844799721eca.png)

Create: Geo-Resonance

This mod brings seismic prospecting to Create: strike terrain, follow returning echoes, read seismograms and generate projections of hidden treasures in your Minecraft world. > Find smarter, mine faster. ***

How It Works

## 1) Strike and Read Echoes Use the **Seismic Hammer** to send pulses and read returns. Hand hammer can assist in finding caves, underground water or lava pools. ![GIF 01 - Hammer pulse and echoes](https://i.imgur.com/6ruk4Uz.gif) *** ## 2) Automate Scans and Find Ores Power the **Seismic Station**, load paper + ink, run scans and collect seismograms - interactive maps of discovered resources. ![GIF 02 - Basic station workflow](https://i.imgur.com/VS0rKTm.gif) Refine scan results with modules to focus on the valuables you need. ![GIF 03 - Station with modules workflow and seismogram showcase](https://i.imgur.com/MxTPPhK.gif) * Noise Cancellation removes cave/water/lava background signals. * Below Zero enables deep-layer detection (`Y < 0`). * Target modules: add specific signatures (ores and other valuables). There are plenty of them. ![PNG OF MODULES](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_fe30c8ec-50a0-490b-ba92-67e82e387806.png) *** ## 3) Project Hidden Targets Load two valid seismograms into the **Seismic Projector** to generate underground projections. ![GIF 04 - Projector flow](https://i.imgur.com/rIVdEfs.gif) New in 1.1.0: Create trains can now carry working Seismic Stations and Projectors. *** ## Compatibility * Minecraft version: `1.20.1` * Loader: `Forge` * Create version: `Create 6.x` * Environment: Client and Server *** ## Install 1. Install Forge `1.20.1` 2. Install Create `6.x` 3. Put mod jar file into `mods`   *** ## Links * Report bugs/suggest features: [GitHub Issues Page](https://github.com/Goldsk1n/CreateGeoResonance/issues) * Source code: [GitHub Page](https://github.com/Goldsk1n/CreateGeoResonance/)
